findings.title: The auditor's own source contains a literal that belongs in policy
findings.reason: 'AKIA' appears in the engine source.  Brand names, model identifiers, provider hostnames and credential prefixes must live in policy/ so that the same auditor works for a different organisation by changing configuration.  A tool that embeds them is not reusable and cannot be trusted to report on them neutrally.
findings.evidence: (``sk-a``, ``ghp_``, ``AKIA``) and reports the length plus digest so the real
findings.recommendation: Move the value into policy/patterns/ or policy/policy.yaml and read it through Config.
